Live on WhatNot at 6pm Central → LEARN MORE Home Pedals and Effects Pedals and Effects Fuzz Death By Audio Supersonic Fuzz Gun Death By Audio Supersonic Fuzz Gun Overview The Supersonic Fuzz Gun from Death By Audio is a wild, unpredictable fuzz pedal built for extreme sonic experimentation. Designed with maximum manipulation in mind, this pedal goes far beyond traditional fuzz—delivering everything from aggressive distortion to chaotic, self-oscillating noise. This is not your standard fuzz. It’s an unruly, expressive sound machine capable of screaming, sputtering, and collapsing into controlled chaos. Extreme Interactive Controls The Supersonic Fuzz Gun features highly interactive controls that influence each other in real time. This creates a vast range of textures that shift dynamically as you play and tweak settings. From gated fuzz to unstable oscillations, every adjustment opens up new tonal territory—making the pedal feel alive and reactive under your fingertips. From Distortion to Total Sonic Chaos While it can produce more straightforward distorted tones, the Supersonic Fuzz Gun truly shines in its ability to create: Gated, sputtering fuzz textures Oscillating, self-generating noise Glitchy, broken-speaker effects Doom-laden low-end destruction High-pitched shrieks and feedback It’s equally at home adding character to riffs or generating its own howls, chirps, and bursts of sound. Built for Experimental Players This pedal is designed for musicians who want to push boundaries. Whether you’re crafting noise, drone, industrial, or experimental rock, the Supersonic Fuzz Gun offers a massive palette of unconventional tones. It rewards exploration and invites players to interact with their gear in new, creative ways. Why Choose the Supersonic Fuzz Gun? Unique, highly interactive fuzz
